title: Build Production AI SaaS
goal: Combine everything into a production-grade, multi-tenant AI SaaS capstone.

project.name: Enterprise AI SaaS (Capstone)
project.prd: A multi-tenant AI SaaS with auth, billing, RAG/agents, observability, and a full production deployment.
project.architecture: FastAPI + Postgres + pgvector + Redis + agents, containerized, on Kubernetes/cloud with CI/CD and monitoring.
tasks: Define scope
Build core features
Test and document
Ship and push to GitHub
